<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Portal · Play</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Newsreader:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#faf9f6;
    --ink:#181916;
    --dim:#767a72;
    --line:#e3e1d9;
    --accent:#3c5c4c;
    --font-fallback: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"]{
    --bg:#14150f;
    --ink:#f2f1ea;
    --dim:#9a9d92;
    --line:#2b2d24;
    --accent:#8fbfa3;
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
      --bg:#14150f; --ink:#f2f1ea; --dim:#9a9d92; --line:#2b2d24; --accent:#8fbfa3;
    }
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;}
  body{
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'Inter', var(--font-fallback);
    min-height:100vh;
  }
  .wrap{
    max-width:640px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:88px 28px 100px;
  }
  header{ margin-bottom:64px; }
  .mark{
    width:30px; height:30px;
    margin-bottom:36px;
  }
  h1{
    font-family:'Newsreader', var(--font-fallback);
    font-weight:500;
    font-style:italic;
    font-size:clamp(30px, 4.4vw, 40px);
    line-height:1.2;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
    margin:0 0 20px;
    max-width:16ch;
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  header p{
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.65;
    color:var(--dim);
    max-width:46ch;
    margin:0;
  }
  .list{
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .row{
    display:block;
    text-decoration:none;
    color:inherit;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:26px 0;
    transition:padding-left 0.2s ease;
  }
  .row:hover{ padding-left:8px; }
